Every six analysis rows must have rank five; an independently authored C++17 elimination reconstructed all 20 triples times 5005 row-subsets, finding no deficiency over F_101 at omega=95, of exact order 5. Each nonzero finite-field minor lifts to a nonzero cyclotomic minor in characteristic zero, proving at most five zero amplitudes. The state delta_0-delta_1 gives support (2,4,4) after moving one selected basis to coordinates by chirp/Fourier unitary. The original attached CHECK.cpp was inspected; its 11,395,440 checks for p=7 were also independently reproduced but are not claimed as new.
